fusions.name: Rolling Swell
fusions.desc: Rolls a swell into the first enemy in its path, dealing 12 damage and knocking it 2.5 tiles back. It has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Idle Exhale
fusions.desc: Exhales a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack Water
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Slow Ebb
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
